Class ShamanicAttributes

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Utility.ShamanicAttributes
public class ShamanicAttributes extends Object
Utility class that tracks a player's shamanic power-ups and active gameplay modifiers. It stores indicators for extra victory points/stars, insurance mechanics that block point losses, and double-reward multipliers triggered upon winning events.

    • setParamByBuilding

      public void setParamByBuilding(InstantEffectBuilding card)
      Appends and merges modifiers provided by an executed instant-effect building card. Boolean parameters are combined using a logical OR operation to ensure that existing active bonuses are safely preserved.

      card - the InstantEffectBuilding instance source containing the bonuses to extract
